title: Case 005: Year of Construction for the Calculation
initial_request: I’m arranging property insurance for 105 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 5ZZ. Please help me respond to the insurer’s question about the year the property was built.
overview: Alderwick Underwriting asked Rory Hale of Fenwick Risk for the construction year recorded as missing from Ivy Cole’s application for 105 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 5ZZ. Rory asked Ivy directly rather than infer a date from the building’s style. Ivy supplied a year she understood to be correct but had not verified, and Rory passed it on explicitly as her estimate. Alderwick acknowledged receipt; no quotation or cover decision is recorded.

next_action.summary: At the clarification stage, Rory should ask Ivy what construction year she knows or believes applies and record any uncertain answer as an estimate, not as a verified fact.

outcome: Rory passed Ivy’s stated construction-year estimate to Alderwick Underwriting, which acknowledged receipt; a calculation has not been promised.

events.body: We have the application for 105 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 5ZZ, but the year of construction is not stated. Please provide the year so we can continue considering the calculation.

Alderwick Underwriting needs the year 105 Willow Walk was built, and it is missing from the application. What year do you understand the property to have been built, and is that something you have verified?
I believe it was built in 1938, based on what the previous owner told me. I have not checked that against any records, so please treat 1938 as my estimate rather than a verified year.
Ivy has given 1938 as her estimate of the construction year and says she has not verified it. I will relay it with that qualification and will not infer a year from the property’s appearance.

For 105 Willow Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 5ZZ, Ivy Cole believes the property was built in 1938, based on information from the previous owner. She has not verified the year, so please record this as her estimate rather than as a confirmed fact.
Received, thank you. We have Ivy Cole’s estimated construction year of 1938 for the application.
